_comment: Fallback US broadcaster per women's competition, keyed by the league codes in bot/espn_fixtures.py. ESPN usually supplies the exact channel per game, so these only show when it does not. Verify each season. Tennis: 'WTA' is the default; 'WTA:<tournament>' overrides it for that event.
NWSL: CBS, Paramount+, Prime Video, ESPN & ION
WNBA: ESPN, ABC, Prime Video, NBC, Peacock & ION
